title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published 'Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition' in the November 1998 issue of Proceedings of the IEEE. The paper reviews gradient-based learning for document recognition and reports convolutional neural networks designed for two-dimensional shape variability, alongside integrated recognition systems using graph transformer networks.
significance: A documented neural-network and document-recognition research milestone centered on convolutional networks, gradient-based learning, and integrated trainable recognition systems.
